title: Morning Robotics Scan
report:
## Awaken-HI

### The Breakthrough
The authors release Awaken‑Human, a 50,000‑hour egocentric stereo video dataset with synchronized whole‑body motion, and train Awaken‑HI, a vision‑language‑action model that jointly predicts human motion and retargeted robot actions, achieving a 93.75% mean success rate across eight tasks on a T800 humanoid, surpassing prior baselines.

### The Caveats
The success rate is demonstrated only on a single T800 robot over eight tasks, leaving generalization to other platforms unverified.

## PGX

### The Breakthrough
PGX separates long‑horizon humanoid loco‑manipulation into a predicate‑driven state machine, VLA skill modules, and world‑coordinate locking, enabling training‑free decomposition that improves stage‑progression reliability and task success on three simulated tasks and a real Unitree G1 robot.

### The Caveats
No baseline or prior‑method comparison is provided, so the claimed improvement cannot be independently verified.

## Mind2Act World

### The Breakthrough
Mind2Act World presents 30 simulated manipulation tasks across three views (Mind, Act, Mind2Act) with 180 configurations and a diagnostic harness that isolates reasoning, execution, or their composition failures, revealing a drop from ~53% (Mind‑only) and ~39% (Act‑only) to only 12% on the combined tasks.

### The Caveats
All results are confined to simulation with no real‑world robot deployment.

## AgentRoboCritic

### The Breakthrough
AgentRoboCritic adds an intent‑grounded critique step where a policy intent is judged by the Muse‑Glimmer‑130B critic, boosting failure‑mode classification accuracy from 32.58% to 74.24% on a 400‑action benchmark and releasing a 12,844‑action annotated dataset for future evaluation.

### The Caveats
The work reports only classification accuracy improvement without end‑to‑end task success metrics or real‑world robot tests.

## ACCORD

### The Breakthrough
ACCORD fuses OpenVINS visual‑inertial tracking with Depth Anything 3 depth estimation to produce online dense metric SLAM from a single camera and IMU, using a pose‑graph of depth‑enhanced submaps and loop‑closure refinement.

### The Caveats
No quantitative comparison to existing dense‑mapping or SLAM baselines is provided.

## Spirula Studio

### The Breakthrough
Spirula Studio is a C++ trainer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that fits up to 10 M SH‑3 Gaussians in 8 GB VRAM, supports NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs via Vulkan (or CUDA), and adds metric‑scale reconstruction plus built‑in SfM, AI masking, and LoMa detection.

### The Caveats
Cross‑vendor efficiency claims lack benchmarks; only visual demos are offered.

## Unitree Go2 Jailbreak

### The Breakthrough
Praetorian uncovered a length‑validation flaw in the btgatt‑server EVP_DecryptUpdate call, allowing a crafted BLE GATT write to crash the service pre‑key and, using the Caeruleus tool, gain root access on a Unitree Go2 quadruped without the AES firmware key.

### The Caveats
Demonstrated on a single device with no systematic testing across firmware versions.

## Fastest Soft Robot

### The Breakthrough
A newly built soft robot achieves motion solely via embedded soft mechanisms, avoiding any onboard electronics, and claims to set the speed record for electronics‑free soft robots.

### The Caveats
No quantitative speed data or comparison to prior designs is provided.

## RoboticsAcademy

### The Breakthrough
RoboticsAcademy bundles ROS, Gazebo, and RViz into a one‑line installable learning platform with step‑by‑step exercises and a “RADI” interface for standardized tutorial packaging and performance monitoring.

### The Caveats
Lacks empirical evidence that the exercises improve learning or transfer to real robots.

### Priority
Awaken‑HI provides the first large‑scale human motion dataset paired with real‑robot success, offering immediate, reproducible progress for embodied AI.

### One action
Download the Awaken‑Human dataset and attempt to reproduce the 93.75% task success on your own humanoid platform.
